svg.title: Two independent standards validate evidence recovery and penetrance calibration
svg.desc: Editable six-panel NIH R01 scientific-results scaffold. Panels A through D evaluate literature recovery against frozen manual adjudication. Panels E and F evaluate penetrance calibration against independent biobank carrier outcomes. No unverified numerical results are displayed.
svg.metadata: Source: GeneVariantFetcher R01 figure scaffold Analysis state: intentionally empty because no frozen verified values were supplied Canvas: 7.2 by 5.8 inches; designed for 2160 by 1740 pixel 300-dpi export Typeface: Avenir Next Condensed, an allowed Avenir Next fallback for Source Sans 3
svg.text: Two independent standards validate evidence recovery
Manual adjudication tests extraction; held-out biobank carriers test generalization

g.text: Gold standard 1 — Frozen manual literature adjudication
Calibration standard 2 — Independent biobank carrier outcomes
Discovery and access failures are scored separately
Accurate evidence recovery is necessary; independent calibration determines whether the estimate generalizes.
